facts.fact: The article advises that users should be able to increase ad text size by 200% while still being able to read it.
facts.quote: The important thing is to ensure that users can increase the size by 200% while maintaining readability.

facts.fact: The StackAdapt blog post on accessible programmatic ads was published on October 25, 2022.
The StackAdapt article presents five tips for creating accessible programmatic ads.
facts.quote: Here are 5 tips to get you started.

facts.fact: The article names Times New Roman, Arial, and Verdana as simple fonts that are accessible for ad text.
facts.quote: Fonts like Times New Roman, Arial, and Verdana are straight forward, and accessible.

facts.fact: The article recommends using a free online contrast checker by WebAIM to confirm that an ad's text and background colour combination has enough contrast.
